phase1DefectsFoundAndFixed.what: Session.close() invalidates health to CLOSED on the caller's thread (ConnectionIngress.close()); landing between the shard's pre-process boundary read and its post-process check marked a deliberate close as an INCOMPLETE recording. Latent in Phase 1 (nanosecond window), made deterministic by Phase 2's added work in that gap.
phase1DefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: A CLOSED bump while session.closing is already set is a deliberate close, not a degrade; all other CLOSED/SHARD_FAILED sources still degrade.
